title: Sort the Numbers
statement:
Put a list of whole numbers in order from smallest to largest. Use your language's built-in sort instead of writing your own.

The first line of the input is a count `n`, from 1 to 1000. The second line holds `n` integers separated by spaces, each between -1000 and 1000. They can be negative and can repeat. Print the numbers in ascending order on one line, separated by single spaces. Keep every repeated number.

Input:

```text
5
4 1 3 5 2
```

Expected output:

```text
1 2 3 4 5
```
hints: Every one of these languages ships with a sort function, so look it up rather than writing a loop.
Some sorts compare items as text by default, which puts 10 before 9. Make sure yours compares them as numbers.
